mainDescription: Formal audit and complaint document — This report presents the complete audit of irregularities committed against the user WazzimaGiygg (Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres), including documented evidence, witnesses, technical analyses and recommendations for judicial and administrative action.
section1Text1: This audit and complaint document aims to formally document all irregularities committed by Lusophone Wikipedia administrators and checkusers against the user WazzimaGiygg, providing concrete evidence, technical analyses and legal basis to support judicial, administrative and disciplinary actions.
objective5: • Establish civil, criminal and administrative liability
warningGravityText: This document formalizes the complaint of multiple crimes (slander, defamation, injury, stalking, device intrusion, criminal association, malicious denunciation) and violations of the LGPD, Marco Civil da Internet and UCoC, with documented evidence and witnesses to support legal action.

judicialActions: Criminal Action: Filing of action against Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine and Johannesn89 for slander, malicious denunciation, criminal association, stalking and device intrusion.
Civil Action for Moral Damages: Claim for compensation for the permanent SEO Damage and for the vexatious public exposure.
Action Against WMF: Subsidiary liability of the Wikimedia Foundation for violations of the LGPD and Marco Civil.
De-indexation Request: Request to Google for removal of search results (right to be forgotten).
administrativeActions: Notification to ANPD: Formal complaint to the National Data Protection Authority about LGPD violations.
Notification to the Public Prosecutor's Office: Criminal and civil complaint to the MP for violations of Brazilian legislation.
Notification to WMF: Formal communication to the Wikimedia Foundation about UCoC violations.
Request for Demotion: Request for immediate removal of the agents involved from all administrative positions.
disciplinaryActions: Global Demotion: Immediate revocation of the administrator, bureaucrat and checkuser status of the agents involved.
Revocation of Privileges: Removal of all administrative tools from the agents involved.
Prohibition of Reinstatement: Prevention of the agents involved from reassuming administrative positions.
Log Audit: Complete review of all administrative actions of the agents involved in the last 2 years.
correctiveActions: LGPD Take-down: Mandatory and definitive removal of Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres's personal data from all public logs.
User Reintegration: Immediate reversal of the block and reintegration into the community.
Public Retraction: Official acknowledgment of the violations and public apology.
Structural Reform: Implementation of rigorous policies to prevent harassment and abuse of power.
executiveText1: The audit identified multiple violations committed by Lusophone Wikipedia administrators and checkusers against the user WazzimaGiygg, including:
executiveText2: Crimes: Slander, defamation, injury, stalking, device intrusion, criminal association, malicious denunciation.
executiveText4: Agents: Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine, Johannesn89.
executiveText5: Damages: Permanent SEO damage, moral damage, professional damage, psychological damage.
auditConclusionText1: The audit concludes that there were systematic and coordinated violations of Brazilian legislation, the Wikimedia Foundation's Universal Code of Conduct and fundamental ethical principles. The agents involved acted with intent, coordination and abuse of power, causing serious and permanent damage to the victim.
auditConclusionText2: Liability is individual and joint among the agents involved, with subsidiary liability of the Wikimedia Foundation.
auditConclusionText3: The immediate adoption of all judicial, administrative and disciplinary actions proposed in this report is recommended.
section10Title: 10. 📢 Call to Action: Justice and Reform
callToActionList: Justice for the Victim: Ensure that those responsible are held civilly and criminally accountable.
Reparation of Damages: Ensure the removal of personal data and compensation for the damages caused.
Governance Reform: Implement structural changes to prevent new abuses.
Radical Transparency: Demand total transparency in administrative actions.
Data Protection: Ensure strict compliance with the LGPD and data retention policy.
End of Impunity: Ensure that abusive administrators are punished and removed.
